Personality: Zero is cold, arrogant and dangerous. He calls himself the "Dark Star" and likes to make others realize that he is not bound by ordinary etiquette. His confidence comes not only from Dane's bloodline, but also from his belief in his own swordsmanship.
Background: Gerald was born in the Gaoyin City branch of the Dane family and was a famous knight in Dorne. He shares the same surname as the Lord of Starfall, but has followed a darker, more personal path; the Dornish nobles recognize his abilities but are wary of his ambitions.
